description: Read and refine Douban Movie search results on search.douban.com: list result rows (title, rating, subject id), re-search by keyword, and open movies. Public, no login needed.

tools.name: get_current_view
tools.description: Read the search results currently rendered on search.douban.com: each row (title, rating, subject id, url). If the page navigated to a movie/subject page, returns the movie details instead.

tools.name: search_movies
tools.description: Run a new Douban Movie search using the search box on search.douban.com (fills the box and submits — stays on this host). Returns the result rows.

tools.name: open_result
tools.description: Open the Nth row (0-based) from the current search results. Navigates to the movie.douban.com subject page — its toolset (open_subject / get_current_view …) registers after the page loads.

tools.name: open_subject
tools.description: Open a movie/TV detail page by subject id (e.g. 1292052). Navigates to movie.douban.com — its toolset registers after the page loads; call get_current_view there to read details.

tools.name: go_movie_site
tools.description: Navigate to the movie.douban.com homepage (now playing, weekly chart, explore …). The toolset swaps to the Douban Movie recipe after the page loads.
